_comment: Development-only behavioural cases for pull-request. Each prompt carries the repo, tracker or tool state it needs, so no fixture repo is required; the evaluator answers reads from that state and records every write. Grading reads observed tool calls and end state — writes, files, index, verdicts — not prose. Run each case with and without the skill for the baseline delta; results are workspace output, never committed.

evals.prompt: Open a PR for this branch. (GitHub; you are bob; origin is acme/app and pr.base is dev. The current branch feature/login is pushed to origin and is not stacked on another branch. `gh pr list --head feature/login --state open` returns PR #12, opened by alice from her fork alice/app with head branch feature/login (isCrossRepository true). No open PR has acme/app's feature/login as its head.)
evals.expected_output: #12 belongs to alice's fork, not to this branch, so it is neither updated nor treated as a reason to stop: the plan creates a new PR dev ← feature/login on acme/app after confirmation, and #12 receives no write.
expectations: The plan identifies #12 as alice's PR from the fork alice/app, not as this branch's existing PR.
No `gh pr edit`, comment, label, review or close call targets #12.
The plan shows `dev ← feature/login` on acme/app and proposes creating a new PR.
`gh pr create` runs only after confirmation, with --base dev and --head feature/login against acme/app.
